resources.name: SubmitHub
resources.description: The original music submission platform. Send your tracks directly to bloggers, playlist curators, and influencers. Free submissions (slow response) or premium credits (~$0.79–$0.98 per credit, 1–4 credits per submission) for guaranteed feedback within 48 hours. New: SubmitHub Ads offers Meta ad campaign management ($120–$200/month minimum), and SubmitHub Ads Studio provides simple video creation for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
resources.cost: Free tier + premium credits ($0.79–$0.98/credit; 1–4 credits per submission)
highlights: NEW: SubmitHub Ads for Meta campaigns

resources.name: Groover
resources.description: Pitch your music to curators, media outlets, influencers, radio stations, and record labels. Pay-per-pitch model with a guaranteed response within 7 days. Strong European, North American, and Asian curator network. Bulk discounts available (up to 24% off).
resources.cost: €1 per Grooviz; 2 Grooviz (~€2/$2.14) per submission (4–6 for top curators)

resources.name: MusoSoup
resources.description: Marketplace where music curators actively search for new music. Submit once for £42 (paid only if approved), then choose free coverage offers or pay for additional curator pitches. Curators come to you — no cold pitching required.
resources.cost: £42 per campaign (paid only if approved); free coverage options included

resources.name: One Submit
resources.description: Submit to over 2,200 music curators across Spotify playlists, TikTok influencers, music blogs, YouTube channels, magazines, and online radio stations — all from a single submission form. Tiered pricing based on playlist size.
resources.cost: Tiered: Spotify playlists (up to 8K followers) $3; (8K–20K) $6; Music blogs $5; TikTok influencers from $5+

resources.name: Songfluencer
resources.description: Music-focused influencer marketing agency that pairs your track with vetted TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creators. They manage the entire campaign — creator selection, briefing, content approval, and reporting. Celebrated 46 Grammy nominations and 13 wins for partnered artists at the 67th Grammy Awards (February 2025), including Kendrick Lamar's 'Not Like Us' (5 awards).
resources.cost: Campaign-based pricing (~$200+/post for mid-sized TikTok accounts)

resources.name: SpaceLoud
resources.description: Self-serve marketplace where artists set their own budgets, browse influencer profiles, and manage campaigns directly. Influencers browse artist campaigns and set their own rates. Founded 2019; no published minimum campaign price.
resources.cost: Set your own budget (fully flexible; no published minimum)

resources.name: Kolsquare
resources.description: Influencer marketing platform with a database of KOL (Key Opinion Leader) profiles across all social platforms. Search by niche, audience demographics, engagement rate, and more. Now part of Team.Blue (acquired October 2024), one of Europe's largest private tech companies.
resources.cost: Enterprise/subscription model (contact for pricing; referenced Campaign tier: $18K/user/year)

resources.name: Playlist Push
resources.description: One of the most established playlist promotion platforms. Matches your music with independent Spotify playlist curators based on genre. Also offers TikTok influencer campaigns. Transparent feedback from every curator. Artist Protection Fund automatically credits back budget for curators who fail to review within 14 days.
resources.cost: Spotify minimum $280/campaign; TikTok ~$280–$500/campaign

resources.name: SubmitLink
resources.description: Connects artists with 5,000+ music professionals including playlist curators, radio DJs, bloggers, and labels. Launched 2019; artists pay per submission (not free). Partners with artist.tools (Spotify's top bot detector, trusted by DistroKid and UnitedMasters) to ensure clean, authentic playlists.
resources.cost: From ~$27 per campaign submission

resources.name: Soundplate
resources.description: Music solutions provider and boutique label offering playlist submission, smart link technology (Soundplate Clicks), pre-save campaigns, bio links, and event tools. Pro Unlimited plan updated to $20/month.
resources.cost: Pro Unlimited: $20/mo or $180/year (25% savings)

resources.name: PlaylistSupply
resources.description: Spotify playlist analytics and discovery tool. Find playlists that match your genre, see their growth trends, identify curators actively adding music, and access full playlist analysis with live follower counts, curator profiles, and popularity rankings.
resources.cost: Subscription-based: $19.99/mo (base); Indie $24.99/mo; Viral $39.99/mo; Record Label $69.99/mo

resources.name: Hypeddit
resources.description: Music promotion platform with free and paid tiers. Core feature: download gates (fans follow or pre-save to unlock free download). Paid plans include Basic ($10/mo) and Pro ($20/mo) with additional features. Strong in EDM; works across genres.
resources.cost: Free tier available; Basic $10/mo; Pro $20/mo (discounts for annual)

resources.name: Playlist Push TikTok
resources.description: Dedicated TikTok campaign service from Playlist Push. Matches your track with verified TikTok creators who integrate your song organically into their content. Artists provide song snippet and creative brief; creators use the sound in videos to build viral momentum.
resources.cost: Minimum ~$500/campaign

resources.name: Indie Music Academy
resources.description: Music marketing education and promotion services with a strong focus on playlist placements and long-term music marketing strategy. Offers courses, coaching, and done-for-you promotion campaigns. Best for artists who want both placements and education.
resources.cost: Courses from $97; promotion campaigns vary (higher price point with proven results)

resources.name: Ditto Music Promotions
resources.description: Promotion arm of Ditto Music distribution. Offers 4-week Promo campaigns and Promo Plus (4 weeks + 2 extra weeks of marketing + paid social advertising). Note: URL redirected from /en/promotions to /en/promo. Campaign pricing not publicly displayed; contact directly.
resources.cost: Campaign packages (contact for pricing; historically ~$100+)

resources.name: Vampr
resources.description: Social platform helping musicians and creatives find collaborators, create new music, and monetize their work. Free app available; Pro pricing not publicly confirmed. Legitimate free app for musician networking and collaboration.
resources.cost: Free app; Pro pricing unclear (verify directly)

resources.name: Feature.fm
resources.description: Smart links, pre-save pages, bounce redirects, territory-based routing, and fan messaging platform. Provides full marketing funnel tools for tracking campaign results. Free Plan (limited), Artist Plan at $9.99/mo (annual) or $14.99/mo (monthly), Pro Plan at $24.99/mo (annual) or $34.99/mo (monthly).
resources.cost: Free tier; Artist Plan $9.99/mo (annual) or $14.99/mo (monthly); Pro $24.99/mo (annual) or $34.99/mo (monthly)

resources.name: Linkfire
resources.description: Industry-standard smart link platform tailored specifically to what artists, labels, and music marketers need. Create beautiful landing pages, track clicks by geography and platform, integrate with ad platforms, and access exclusive partnerships with major streaming services on streaming insights.
resources.cost: Free trial available; Creator plans start at $10/mo

resources.name: ToneDen
resources.description: ⚠️ CAUTION: Social marketing suite with smart links, social unlocks (fan-gating), and automated ad campaigns. Primary domain fanlink.to broke in March 2024; migrated to fanlink.tv. Parent company Eventbrite acquired by Bending Spoons in December 2025 (~$500M deal). Future uncertain. Pricing much higher than listed: cheapest paid option is $50/mo, climbing to $1,300/mo. Use with caution.
resources.cost: ⚠️ CHANGED: Minimum $50/mo (can reach $1,300/mo); fanlink.to domain broken (use fanlink.tv)

resources.name: Songwhip
resources.description: Free, instant smart link generator. Paste any music link and get a clean landing page with all streaming platforms. Acquired by Linktree in August 2021 and still operational, but development has slowed. No pre-saves, email capture, or ad tools — purely link aggregation. Free.
resources.cost: Free

resources.name: Feedspot
resources.description: Database of 250,000+ active influencers across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter in 1,500+ niche categories. Search for music influencers by platform, genre, and audience size. Offers contact lists with email addresses. Website active; pricing not confirmed in current searches.
resources.cost: Lists ~$99 one-time (verify directly for current pricing)

resources.name: Social Blade
resources.description: Free analytics tool for checking any public social media account's follower growth, engagement trends, and estimated earnings. Essential for vetting influencers before outreach — spot fake followers, view growth trends, and identify declining accounts.
resources.cost: Free; Premium from $3.99/mo

resources.name: HypeAuditor
resources.description: AI-powered influencer analytics and fraud detection platform. Analyzes audience quality, engagement authenticity, and demographics. Forever-free plan for basic reports; paid plans from $299/mo Starter tier (four variations available depending on features and social networks).
resources.cost: Free basic reports; Starter plan $299/mo (multiple tier options)

resources.name: Chartmetric
resources.description: Music industry analytics platform that tracks playlist placements, social media growth, and audience data across all platforms. See which playlists and influencers are driving streams for artists in your genre. Pricing tiers not confirmed in current searches.
resources.cost: Free tier available; Pro pricing verify directly (historically ~$120/mo for Pro)

resources.name: SpotOnTrack
resources.description: ⚠️ UNCERTAIN: Free Spotify analytics tool that tracks playlist placements, follower growth, and streaming trends. Low web presence in 2025–2026; status unclear. Recommend verifying directly if still active.
resources.cost: Free (if operational)
highlights: ⚠️ Low recent web presence — verify status

resources.name: SoundCampaign
resources.description: Described as the largest playlist pitching service, generating over 157.2 million streams for artists. Offers transparent pricing, real curator feedback, and Artist Protection Program ensuring money is safe if curators don't engage. Actively referenced as strong Playlist Push alternative in 2025–2026.
resources.cost: Contact platform for current pricing

resources.name: TikTok for Artists
resources.description: Official TikTok music insights and analytics platform launched June 2025. Helps artists build careers, connect with fans, improve promotional efforts, and inform content creation on TikTok. Includes new Pre-Release tool allowing fans to pre-save albums directly to Spotify or Apple Music from TikTok. Free native platform tool.
resources.cost: Free

resources.name: un:hurd music
resources.description: All-in-one music marketing platform specializing in automated campaigns and AI-driven promotional insights. Rapidly becoming top choice for independent artists. Received fresh investment from EMPIRE in early 2025. Top choice for comprehensive music marketing in 2025.
resources.cost: Contact platform for pricing
